title: Install, initialize, or recover Milieu
summary: Install Milieu and its matching provider bundle, initialize private schema-two state, diagnose local readiness, add source metadata, or recover retained programs without collection.
use_when: Milieu should be installed, initialized, diagnosed or recovered.
The caller needs to add a retained careers source or verify local state.
do_not_use_when: A current discovery run or a read-only employer/opportunity export is the requested outcome.
A schedule, provider subscription purchase, credential change, database deletion or downstream action is intended.
outcome: An installed matching program/documentation release, initialized schema-two state, supported local diagnostic result, source enrollment, or selected retained program release.
effects: Direct installation stages an immutable frontend, Rust payload, Rust installer and exact provider bundle and advances only Milieu-owned command/provider selectors. Deployment also initializes state. It creates no schedule.
Init creates missing private schema-two state and preserves supported existing records. Schema-one state is rejected without migration. Diagnostics start no searches.
The installed frontend passes only its documented environment without sourcing ~/.zshrc or extracting provider keys.

Source add retains an explicit source without fetching it. Ordinary websites may use an existing company ID or a hostname candidate; supported ATS URLs use canonical provider/tenant associations and reject --company-id.
authority: Milieu owns its installation, supported state schema, source enrollment, and local diagnostics.
The operator selects artifacts and state. Consumers own personal selection and downstream actions.
success: Installation selects supplied commands and documentation without executable probes.
Initialization, source enrollment or diagnosis returns its documented local outcome and supported reads confirm the intended result.
failure_and_recovery: Deployment refuses foreign selectors and stale expected selections. A failed instruction retains completed changes for explicit recovery.
Program recovery preserves current Milieu data and does not check schema compatibility. Select a compatible program; do not hand-edit SQLite rows.
Unsupported state schemas fail explicitly without migration. Local readiness does not establish current source availability.

Older releases requiring stored collector configuration can fail status or diagnosis on newly initialized Milieu 0.6.0 state even if they read schema-two exports. Recovery does not recreate configuration.
privacy: State and exports can contain posting text, source locators, evidence and dates. Keep them private.
Milieu reads no provider credentials or executable user shell configuration.
does_not_authorize: Selecting opportunities for the user, creating CRM cases or application packets, sending email, submitting applications, invoking an agent or browser, or enabling a schedule.
Changing provider billing, automatic purchases, another product installation, or deleting retained state.

consumers.statement: The current user may follow this procedure for program installation or recovery, schema-two state initialization, local diagnosis and source enrollment.

preconditions.statement: Select intended committed source and explicit deployment products, or a trusted installer and retained release for recovery. Preserve accepted records and stop callers before state maintenance or recovery.

inputs.statement: Submit committed source through ./ci.sh submit COMMIT --deploy milieu from the Cell root. --settings ABSOLUTE_JSON supplies private JSON whose milieu object contains optional absolute state_dir; Telete freezes settings. Recovery selects a canonical compatible retained release path. Source enrollment takes a URL and optional ordinary-website company identity. No config_file setting exists.

CI and Telete are the sole Cell deployment route. Submit ./ci.sh submit COMMIT --deploy milieu from the Cell root and add required product updates explicitly. Telete validates, prepares signed programs, executes product instructions and retains job and deployment outcomes. Product-owned bootstrap, platform package maintenance and explicit recovery keep their separate supported interfaces.

outputs.statement: Supported reads verify selected program metadata, local state and diagnosis, and source identity, URL and company association after the operation. Ordinary status schema 3 supplies local record counts.

data_semantics.statement: Artifact selection, usable local state and current external posting availability are separate outcomes. State and installation feature contracts own their full meanings.

identity_and_units.statement: Verify exact release selection, selected state directory, and enrolled source identity. milieu.discovery.explore owns stable record identities and current revisions.
Program archives retain release identities. Running executable files are regular files beneath Milieu/install/runtime and keep the same actual path across install and recovery.

completeness_and_freshness.statement: Checks describe selected local artifacts and state at invocation. Source enrollment retains metadata without establishing retrieval or coverage.
Installation and local diagnosis do not establish current external source availability or successful collection.

access.statement: Use supported tested installer and current-user CLI interfaces. Keep program paths user-owned and state/exports/diagnostics private. Chancery reading is optional installed documentation and performs no product work.

lifecycle_and_consistency.statement: Follow owning feature installation and state lock boundaries. Verify matching selectors after installation or recovery and preserve prior Milieu data.

operational_limits.statement: This procedure starts no collection and creates no schedule, model job or downstream application result. Missing state uses schema 2; schema-one state is rejected without migration. It authorizes no provider purchase, credential replacement, destructive reset or manual row repair.
Stop on foreign public selectors, displaced active ownership or unsupported recovery.

Deploy accepts one bounded schema-two recipe request on stdin. The product command owns its setup; the shared executor uses process exit status only. Deployment runs no application execution probe, native-signature audit, maintenance hold, drain, or automatic rollback.

compatibility_and_evolution.statement: Operation contract 8 retires collector configuration, ownership reconciliation and source disabling. Required features explain schema-two-only state, local status schema 3, doctor schema 2, frontend environment and unchanged export/native Snapshot compatibility. Program recovery restores no state.

New state has no collector configuration. Existing metadata can retain old configuration values inertly; Milieu does not read or replace them. Older releases requiring those values can fail status or diagnosis on new state even if they support schema-two exports. Program recovery recreates no configuration.

reliances.statement: Program selection and recovery follow Milieu-owned release metadata and selector rules.
State setup and source enrollment follow Milieu-owned schema, accepted-record and local readiness rules.
Verification uses Milieu's retained record and export meanings.

steps: Select intended operator home and state directory, inspect current records and choose the authorized local operation.
Install supplied binary and bundle through a trusted tested candidate, then inspect release metadata and register usage.
Initialize missing schema-two state and inspect local readiness and record counts.
Add an exact source and verify identity and company association without treating enrollment as collection success.
Recover a canonical retained release. Preserve Milieu data and select programs compatible with its schema.
checkpoints: The tested candidate and provider release match and all selectors belong to Milieu.
Selected state uses supported database schema 2 and accepted records remain.
Local readiness is separate from current external posting availability.
Source enrollment has the intended source identity, URL and company association.
Program recovery leaves state unchanged and the selected program accepts its schema.
adaptation: Use the selected installed release and state; do not infer readiness from catalog presence.
Read product/show/resolve after installation when Chancery is available; Milieu remains useful without a reader.
stop_when: A public selector is foreign, an expected selection changed, or an active writer would be displaced.
Proposed recovery requires unsupported row edits, destructive reset or an incompatible program/state pair.
